brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build provides a shelf surface (3× full hex bases at 0,0,0 / 0,1,0 / 1,0,0 with full top covers cover:0,0,0;full;top, cover:0,1,0;full;top, cover:1,0,0;full;top) reinforced with jointBolts (jointBolt:0#0,0#0, jointBolt:0#0,0#5, jointBolt:0#0,1#1) and side connectors (connector:0#0,0|0,1, connector:0#0,0|1,0). However per configurator rules this system checks fit/meshClash only, not strength: no part in catalog carries a verified 50 kg load rating (check_build meshClash=clear, no load check). Do not claim load ratings.

Two notch drawer frames installed: notch:0#1,1#notch2 at 1,1,0 k=2 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) and notch:0#1,-1#notch4 at 1,-1,0 k=4. Both sit in empty cells between paired bases (0,0,0-0,1,0 and 0,0,0-1,0,0) providing drawer functionality.

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell shelf deck with full top covers and structural reinforcement (joint bolts + side connectors) plus two notch drawer frames. Mesh clash is clear. No verified 50 kg rating exists in Hex Cluster configurator — this system only validates fit, not structural load — so the shelf rating cannot be certified; the drawers requirement is fully met.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
